goal: Session management review: session IDs, expiry, rotation on sign-in and revocation.
use: Session management review: session IDs, expiry, rotation on sign-in and revocation. Use when code creates, stores or ends sessions.

steps.note: Check creation. Sessions need random IDs of enough length.
Check rotation. The ID must change after sign-in.
Check expiry. Flag sessions with no idle or absolute timeout.
Check revocation. Sign-out and password change must end the session.
Report. Each finding with file and line, severity and the fix.
